traits.fidelity: Results identical to the established GitHub CLI behaviour the governed publication flow was reviewed against.
traits.zero_config: Works with no operator opt-in or extra configuration.
traits.headless: Runs without a host binary or interactive login (containers, remote workers).

evidence: libs/core/vcs/gh-cli-host-provider.ts (fixed gh argv mirroring the sync github.ts verbs, including --match-head-commit on merge; available when `gh --version` succeeds)
libs/core/vcs/github-rest-host-provider.ts (GitHub REST/GraphQL via governed secureFetch; available only when GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN is registered; merge sends the approved head as `sha`)
libs/core/vcs/vcs-host.test.ts (shared contract suite: gh-cli and github-rest normalize the same forge fixture identically)
libs/core/vcs/memory-vcs-host-provider.ts (in-process forge for hermetic tests; never registered by default and never in the default chain)

publish.description: Create, inspect and merge pull requests for the active checkout under governed approval.

headless_publish.description: The same operations from a runtime without the gh binary (container or remote worker).
